title: English IV: Spelling, Error Spotting & Usage
desc: Spelling, sentence correction, confused words and punctuation

questions.q: Select the correctly spelt word:
Choose the word that best completes: The judge showed ___ to the young offender.
Choose the word that best completes: The teacher's ___ was clear to every student.
Choose the word that best completes: The child was ___ for stealing a toy.
Choose the word that best completes: The new law will ___ child labour.
Choose the word that best completes: The NGO works to ___ the rights of orphans.
Choose the word that best completes: His ___ behaviour surprised everyone.
Choose the word that best completes: The government's ___ to the flood victims was prompt.
Choose the word that best completes: He was ___ from the school for misconduct.
Choose the word that best completes: The orphanage provides ___ and education to children.
Choose the word that best completes: She has a ___ attitude towards work.
Identify the error: 'He do not like tea.'
questions.e: It should be 'He does not like tea'.

questions.q: Identify the error: 'She is more taller than me.'
questions.e: Say 'taller' or 'more tall' but not both.

questions.q: Identify the error: 'The informations are useful.'
Identify the error: 'I am knowing him since 2010.'
questions.e: Stative verbs like 'know' are not used in continuous tenses.

questions.q: Identify the error: 'He gave me an advice.'
questions.e: 'Advice' is uncountable; say 'a piece of advice'.

questions.q: Identify the error: 'Each of the students have passed.'
Identify the error: 'One of my friends are a doctor.'
Identify the error: 'He is taller than any boy in his class.'
Identify the error: 'Scarcely had he left when it rained.'
Identify the error: 'I prefer reading than writing.'
Choose the correctly punctuated sentence:
o: Is she coming to the party.
Is she coming to the party!
Is, she coming to the party
Is she coming to the party?
questions.e: A direct question ends with a question mark.

Choose the correct use of 'their/there/they're':
o: Their waiting for they're bus over there.
They're waiting for their bus over there.
There waiting for there bus over their.

questions.q: Choose the correct use of 'affect/effect':
o: The rain will effect the crops.
The rain will have an affect.
The rain will affect the crops.
questions.e: 'Affect' is usually a verb; 'effect' a noun.

questions.q: Choose the correct use of 'principal/principle':
o: The principle of the school came.

questions.q: Choose the correct use of 'stationary/stationery':
o: He bought stationary from the shop.
He bought stationery from the shop.
questions.e: 'Stationary' means not moving; 'stationery' means writing materials.

questions.q: Choose the correct use of 'complement/compliment':
Which is a simple sentence?
o: The child sleeps because he is tired.
The child sleeps and the mother reads.
If the child sleeps, we will go.
questions.e: A simple sentence has one independent clause.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the future perfect tense?
o: I will have finished by noon.
questions.e: Future perfect = will have + past participle.

questions.q: Which sentence is in the present perfect continuous tense?
o: She has been working since morning.
